description: We're building a multidisciplinary team for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, focusing on Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data.Goal is to develop a practical solution that uses NASA observations and agricultural insights to help farmers explore climate-resilient crop rotation strategies. We're looking for passionate developers, data enthusiasts, agriculture students, researchers, and designers who want to build something with real-world impact. Let's turn space data into solutions for Earth!
